panels.name: The Kid returns to the Highway 61
panels.summary: The Kid returns to the Highway 61 crossroads ten years later. His candy-apple red Cadillac convertible is parked on the dusty shoulder. The wealthy 29-year-old superstar stands in the exact center of the dirt intersection where he signed the contract. Thick bayou fog drifts across the desolate landscape.
panels.caption: He drove all night to the crossroad on 61 and stood in the same spot he'd signed.
